          <h5 class="card-title">Bayesian Statistics</h5>
          <p class="card-text">
            Probabilistic models that quantify uncertainty honestly &mdash; ranging from hierarchical mixed-effects models
            to latent variable structure. Useful when you need to pool information across groups, handle small samples,
            or communicate confidence ranges rather than point estimates.
          </p>
